_comment: Stories 18.1-18.5: the Codex, the Dragon Eye Book (scripts/menus/codex_menu.gd and scripts/menus/codex/*_chapter.gd; the book in the hall: scenes/game/CodexLectern.tscn). Every word here is a DRAFT (Raphael rewrites). chapters: the tabs, in order: id (a chapter builder in codex_menu.gd's CHAPTER_SCRIPTS; an unknown id shows a stub page), tab (its label), title (heads the left page). The look is a PLACEHOLDER drawn in code (the leather cover, two parchment pages, a gutter, ribbon tabs, a teal eye clasp; nodes Placeholder*) until Story 25.19/25.20's art: spread = a texture path drawn as a nine-patch with spread_margins [left, top, right, bottom] px (empty: the placeholder); pages = the left and right page rects [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the spread (where the content goes; the placeholder's pages are drawn there too); size = the spread at 1920x1080, scaled down to fit max_screen_fraction of a smaller window; placeholder = its colours; font_sizes = px. lectern_body: a scene that replaces the hall book's placeholder body (Story 18.5; empty: the placeholder book on the trunk); lectern_prompt: its E prompt; lectern_glow: its eye's pulse (emission energy min..max over period seconds). read_dwell_seconds: the page the book opens on counts as read (the "[Codex] read:" line a playtest counts) only after this long in view; a page the reader picks counts at once. text: every line the book shows; {x} are filled in by the chapter.
